description:
The Kitten Who Was Afraid of the Dark: Nightlight Courage! — Whiskers the kitten thought the shadowy coat rack in his room was a giant eight-armed monster! How did he conquer the dark?
Kids science answer for "overcoming fear of the dark bedtime story kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Darkness is just the absence of light, not a spooky monster; when you turn on your curiosity flashlight, familiar shapes appear safe and warm.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
